score_reason: Event dated 13 Oct 2026, before the 14 Oct window; access limited to the top paid tier.
headline: Google has built its Antigravity coding agent into the Gemini app for Mac, available to its top-tier AI Ultra subscribers.
importance_line: Subscribers on Google's most expensive plan can write apps from inside the Gemini Mac app, but everyone else is left out for now.
summary: 9to5Google reports that on 13 Oct 2026 Google brought Antigravity, its agent-first software development platform, into the Gemini app for macOS alongside the Gemini 4 Argon model rollout, so users can build apps and web pages without leaving the app. Argon needs an AI Pro plan or higher, while Antigravity access requires AI Ultra; the Mac app also gains a Chat and Task switcher and a Scheduled view.
